analogue: Gas-phase pinonaldehyde reacting after uptake on sulfuric acid/ammonium sulfate particles, giving oligomeric particle material.
citation: Reactive uptake of pinonaldehyde on acidic aerosols
evidence: Particle spectra showed fragments heavier than the pinonaldehyde monomer after vapor exposure. Uptake depended strongly on acidity and was absent on neutral ammonium sulfate in the authors' controls.
difference: V_A is an unresolved pool rather than identified pinonaldehyde. Nominally neutral Manchester seed differs from the acidic seed that gave reactive uptake; neither an uptake coefficient nor permanent coating retention transfers directly.
